30629-chicken-little-jane-on-the-big-joh.title: Chicken Little Jane
30629-chicken-little-jane-on-the-big-joh.creator: Lily Munsell Ritchie
30629-chicken-little-jane-on-the-big-joh.description: A book by Lily Munsell Ritchie. Little at intervals for the past ten minutes. Providence did not seem to have designed Mrs. Morton for frying doughnuts. She was very sensitive to heat and had little taste for cooking. She had laid aside her silks and laces on coming to the ranch, but the poise and dignity that come from years of gentle living were still hers. Her formal manner always seemed a trifle out of place in the old farm kitchen.

arxiv-2012-13280.creator: A. Eloy, O. Boughdad, M. Albert, P.-É. Larré, F. Mortessagne, M. Bellec, C. Michel
arxiv-2012-13280.description: Abstract I Photorefractive effect and effective nonlinear index variation The basic mechanism of the photorefractive (PR) effect remains in the photogeneration and displacement of mobile charge carriers driven by an external electric field E_{0} denz2003 . The induced permanent space-charge electric field thus implies a modulation of the refractive index of the crystal, \Delta n(I,\mathbf{r})=-0.

arxiv-2103-14754.title: ViralFP: A webserver of viral fusion proteins
arxiv-2103-14754.creator: Pedro Moreira, Ana Marta Sequeira, Sara Pereira, Rúben Rodrigues, Miguel Rocha, Diana Lousa
arxiv-2103-14754.description: Abstract . Viral fusion proteins are attached to the membrane of enveloped viruses (a group that includes Coronaviruses, Dengue, HIV and Influenza) and catalyze fusion between the viral and host membranes, enabling the virus to insert its genetic material into the host cell.

arxiv-2105-03521.title: Stochastic Properties of EIP-1559 Basefees
arxiv-2105-03521.creator: Ian C. Moore, PhD, Jagdeep Sidhu, MSc
arxiv-2105-03521.description: Abstract EIP-1559 is a new proposed pricing mechanism for the Ethereum protocol developed to mitigate short-term volatility in demand for transactions. To properly understand this as a stochastic process, it is necessary to develop the mathematical foundations to understand under what conditions the base fee gas price outcomes behave as a stationary process, and when it does not.

arxiv-2204-06634.title: Seaweed algebras
arxiv-2204-06634.creator: Alex Cameron, Vincent E. Coll, Jr, Nicholas Mayers, Nicholas Russoniello
arxiv-2204-06634.description: Abstract The index of a Lie algebra is an important algebraic invariant, but it is notoriously difficult to compute. However, for the suggestively-named seaweed algebras, the computation of the index can be reduced to a combinatorial formula based on the connected components of a “meander”: a planar graph associated with the algebra.

arxiv-2212-07179.title: FLAGS Framework for Comparative Analysis of Federated Learning Algorithms Journal: Internet of Things
arxiv-2212-07179.creator: Ahnaf Hannan Lodhi, Barış Akgün, Öznur Özkasap
arxiv-2212-07179.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has become a key choice for distributed machine learning. Initially focused on centralized aggregation, recent works in FL have emphasized greater decentralization to adapt to the highly heterogeneous network edge. Among these, Hierarchical, Device-to-Device and Gossip Federated Learning (HFL, D2DFL & GFL respectively) can be considered as foundational FL algorithms employing fundamental aggregation strategies.

arxiv-2305-02094.title: Speed limits of the laser-induced phase transition in FeRh
arxiv-2305-02094.creator: M. Mattern, J. Jarecki, J. A. Arregi, V. Uhlíř, M. Rössle, M. Bargheer
arxiv-2305-02094.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by M. Mattern, J. Jarecki, J. A. Arregi, V. Uhlíř, M. Rössle, M. Bargheer. We use ultrafast x-ray diffraction (UXRD) and the polar time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect (tr-MOKE) to study the laser-induced metamagnetic phase transition in two FeRh films with thicknesses below and above the optical penetration depth. In the thin film, we identify an intrinsic timescale for the light-induced nucleation of ferromagnetic (FM) domains in the antiferromagnetic material of 8 ​ ps 8\,\text{ps} that is substantially slower than the speed of sound.

arxiv-2412-11376.title: ChatTime: A Unified Multimodal Time Series Foundation Model Bridging Numerical and Textual Data
arxiv-2412-11376.creator: Chengsen Wang Qi Qi Jingyu Wang, Haifeng Sun Zirui Zhuang Jinming Wu Lei Zhang Jianxin Liao
arxiv-2412-11376.description: Abstract Human experts typically integrate numerical and textual multimodal information to analyze time series. However, most traditional deep learning predictors rely solely on unimodal numerical data, using a fixed-length window for training and prediction on a single dataset, and cannot adapt to different scenarios. The powered pre-trained large language model has introduced new opportunities for time series analysis.

arxiv-2502-07562.title: LoRP-TTS: Low-Rank Personalized Text-To-Speech
arxiv-2502-07562.creator: Łukasz Bondaruk, Jakub Kubiak
arxiv-2502-07562.description: Abstract Speech synthesis models convert written text into natural-sounding audio. While earlier models were limited to a single speaker, recent advancements have led to the development of zero-shot systems that generate realistic speech from a wide range of speakers using their voices as additional prompts. However, they still struggle with imitating non-studio-quality samples that differ significantly from the training datasets.

arxiv-2506-16753.title: Off-Policy Actor-Critic for Adversarial Observation Robustness: Virtual Alternative Training via Symmetric Policy Evaluation
arxiv-2506-16753.creator: Kosuke Nakanishi, Akihiro Kubo, Yuji Yasui, Shin Ishii
arxiv-2506-16753.description: Abstract Recently, robust reinforcement learning (RL) methods designed to handle adversarial input observations have received significant attention, motivated by RL’s inherent vulnerabilities. While existing approaches have demonstrated reasonable success, addressing worst-case scenarios over long time horizons requires both minimizing the agent’s cumulative rewards for adversaries and training agents to counteract them through alternating learning.

arxiv-2509-02298.title: Measurement of dome turbulence intensity from scintillation pattern in the pupil of the telescope
arxiv-2509-02298.creator: Victor G. Kornilov, Matwey V. Kornilov, Boris S. Safonov, Anton S. Mironov, Dmitry V. Cheryasov, Igor A. Gorbunov, Ivan A. Strakhov
arxiv-2509-02298.description: Abstract We present measurements of optical turbulence (OT) power inside the telescope dome using an instrument registering fluctuations of intensity of a bright star at a plane conjugated to − 2 -2 km below the pupil of the telescope — Domecam. The measurements were conducted at the 2.

arxiv-2510-00474.creator: David Cheban
arxiv-2510-00474.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to study the problem of existence of remotely almost periodic solutions for the scalar differential equation x ′ = f ⁡ ( t , x ) , x^{\prime}=f(t,x), where f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ f:\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R} is a continuous, monotone in x x and remotely almost periodic in t t function.

arxiv-2512-18594.creator: Sanjib Basu, Navdeep Tamang
arxiv-2512-18594.description: Abstract . This paper presents a generalized version of a theorem of Grzegorek and Labuda in category bases and also endeavours to establish a variant formulation of the same in Marczewski structures. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification AMS 1. INTRODUCTION In [3] Grzegorek and Labuda gave a common abstraction of two theorems of Sierpiński.

pmc-10600214.title: Analysis of cell-specific transcriptional responses in human colon tissue using CIBERSORTx
pmc-10600214.creator: Yueqin He, Julia Nicole DeBenedictis, Florian Caiment, Simone G. J. van Breda, Theo M. C. M. de Kok
pmc-10600214.description: Diet is an important determinant of overall health, and has been linked to the risk of various cancers. To understand the mechanisms involved, transcriptomic responses from human intervention studies are very informative. However, gene expression analysis of human biopsy material only represents the average profile of a mixture of cell types that can mask more subtle, but relevant cell-specific changes.

pmc-10617276.title: Secondary infections in critically ill patients with COVID-19 receiving steroid therapy
pmc-10617276.creator: Alex K Pearce, Qais Zawaydeh, W Cameron McGuire, Abdurrahman Husain, Claudia Ayoub, Daniel A Sweeney, Shannon A Cotton, Atul Malhotra
pmc-10617276.description: Secondary infections can occur during or after the treatment of an initial infection. Glucocorticoids may decrease mortality in patients with severe COVID-19; however, risk of secondary infection is not well described. Our primary objective was to investigate the risk of secondary infection among critically ill patients with COVID-19 treated with glucocorticoids.

pmc-10653698.title: Prevalence and analysis of acquired and transmitted integrase strand transfer inhibitor-associated HIV-1 drug resistance in Chongqing, China
pmc-10653698.creator: Huizheng Zhang, Ping Wu, Jungang Li, Mei Li
pmc-10653698.description: In this study, we examined the occurrence of acquired and transmitted drug resistance to integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI) in HIV-1 strains in Chongqing (China) for guiding for the routine testing of INSTI-associated HIV-1 genotype resistance. Plasma samples were obtained from HIV-1 patients at Chongqing Public Health Medical Center from July 2019 to August 2022.

pmc-11508319.title: Pulmonary Congestion and Anemia in Hemodialysis: The Potential Link to Inflammation
pmc-11508319.creator: Saleh Kaysi, Bakhtar Pacha, Marie-Hélène Antoine, Eric De Prez, Joëlle Nortier, Natasha Irrera
pmc-11508319.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pulmonary congestion (PC) is common in hemodialysis (HD) patients. We explored the association of anemia and pulmonary congestion in HD patients. A prospective pilot observational study included 18 patients on maintenance HD. Individual B-lines scores (BLS; 8-sites method) were obtained by lung ultrasound, before and after the first two consecutive HD sessions of the week (HD1-HD2), with different inter-dialytic intervals (68 vs. Bioimpedance spectroscopy body composition (BIS) was performed before each HD session.

pmc-11610287.title: Rapid test for Mycobacterium leprae infection: a practical tool for leprosy
pmc-11610287.creator: Louise Pierneef, Anouk van Hooij, Danielle de Jong, Gaby Wassenaar, Els Verhard, Elisa Tjon Kon Fat, Nadine Engel, Marufa Khatun, Santosh Soren, Abu Sufian Chowdhury, Colette van Hees, Paul Corstjens, Annemieke Geluk
pmc-11610287.description: BackgroundDetection of infection with Mycobacterium leprae allows timely prophylactic treatment, thereby reducing transmission as well as the risk of permanent, leprosy-associated nerve damage. However, since there is no worldwide-implemented standard test for M. leprae infection, detection of infection in asymptomatic individuals remains a major challenge for control programs in endemic areas.

pmc-12398610.title: Tailoring bidirectional electronic transfer interaction tunnels triggers sustainable and high activity of ozone catalysis for water purification
pmc-12398610.creator: Zilong Song, Jiaguang Xu, Liuqing Zhang, Chun He, Paul Westerhoff, Xin Yang
pmc-12398610.description: Heterogeneous catalytic ozonation shows promise in destroying organic pollutants in water, yet developing catalysts with both high activity and stability remains challenging. In this study, we propose a catalyst design strategy involving the anchoring of electron-sharing sites near single-atom sites to construct bidirectional electron transfer interaction tunnels.

pmc-12511400.title: Acrylamide-mediated errors in the cell cycle regulation are associated with altered TORC2 signaling in Schizosaccharomyces pombe
pmc-12511400.creator: Alica Navrátilová, Marek Kovár, Lucia Klongová, Anetta Bakošová, Mária Peťková, Miroslava Požgajová
pmc-12511400.description: Acrylamide (AA) poses a significant risk to living organisms as it is linked to serious health concerns. AA exposure triggers oxidative stress in cells through elevated ROS and modulation of antioxidant enzymes activities and expression of genes encoding antioxidant enzymes.

pmc-12559790.title: Semaglutide Exacerbates Stunting in Growth-Impaired Juvenile Male Mice via Reduced Energy Metabolism
pmc-12559790.creator: Amélie Joly, Lucas Rebiffé, Yves Dusabyinema, Julien Dellinger, Estelle Caillon, Karine Gauthier, François Leulier, Filipe De Vadder
pmc-12559790.description: Animals rely on linear growth to attain their full adult size. The regulators of this multifactorial process, including environmental and endocrine cues, are still incompletely understood. Notably, GLP-1, glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) has emerged as a potential player in this process.

pmc-12963175.title: Symptoms of depression and anxiety are early predictors of multi-domain disability progression in progressive MS
pmc-12963175.creator: Romy A. M. Klein Kranenbarg, Katelijn M. Blok, Yifan van Hasselt, Sylvia Melisse, Nabil Asahaad, Christiaan de Brabander, Franka Claes, Ilse Hoppenbrouwers, Naghmeh Jafari, Luuk van Rooij, Johnny Samijn, Joost Smolders, Beatrijs Wokke, Janet de Beukelaar
pmc-12963175.description: IntroductionIn multiple sclerosis (MS), depression and anxiety are common, yet their relation to disease progression is unclear. We investigated whether Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) symptoms predict neurological disability progression.MethodsIn our prospective cohort of people with primary progressive MS (PPMS), depressive and anxiety symptoms were assessed using HADS.

pmc-13026831.title: The Clinical Role of the Adenoid Microbiome in the Development of Adenoid Hypertrophy and Otitis Media with Effusion
pmc-13026831.creator: Oļegs Sokolovs-Karijs, Monta Brīvība, Dita Gudrā, Rihards Saksis, Annija Alise Zodāne, Maija Rozenberga, Laura Bunka, Anna Frigotto, Jana Osīte, Aigars Reinis, Gunta Segliņa, Angelika Krūmiņa
pmc-13026831.description: Background: The adenoid surface serves as a potential bacterial reservoir for upper respiratory tract pathologies, including Adenoid Hypertrophy (AH) and Otitis Media with Effusion (OME). While dysbiosis is implicated in the pathogenesis of these conditions, it remains unclear whether the microbiome of children with otitis media differs significantly from those with simple hypertrophy when compared against a healthy baseline.

pmc-13092582.title: Late reoperative surgery after laparoscopic pancreaticoduodenectomy: A novel pancreaticogastrostomy Based on the "Modified Blumgart" Philosophy (with video)
pmc-13092582.creator: Yu Cai, Xiangjie Su, Xiaohong Liu, Yong Peng, Xingzhi Li, Ankang Wang, Yuan Feng
pmc-13092582.description: Highlights•Modified Blumgart pancreaticogastrostomy for recurrence or anastomotic stricture.•Avoidance of jejunal mobilization.•Mucosa-to-mucosa pancreatic-gastric adaptation reduces hemorrhage.•Locking mattress suture ensures hemostasis, eliminates dead space.•Separate suturing of duct/gastric walls reduces pancreaticogastric anastomotic gap. Introduction Laparoscopic pancreaticoduodenectomy (LPD) has been established as a standard procedure for tumors of the pancreatic head [1].

pmc-13100160.title: Taxonomic descriptions of Nocardia anocheti sp. nov. and Streptomyces odontomachicola sp. nov. isolated from ants
pmc-13100160.creator: Achiraya Somphong, Tuangrat Tunvongvinis, Chanwit Suriyachadkun, Weeyawat Jaitrong, Enjuro Harunari, Somboon Tanasupawat, Wongsakorn Phongsopitanun
pmc-13100160.description: Two novel actinomycete strains, AG03ᵀ and ODS28ᵀ, were isolated from worker ants Anochetus graeffei and Odontomachus simillimus, respectively, collected in Thailand. Strain AG03ᵀ exhibited the highest 16S rRNA gene sequence similarity (98.28%) to Nocardia grenadensis NBRC 108939ᵀ, whereas strain ODS28ᵀ showed the highest similarity (97.73%) to Actinacidiphila bryophytorum NEAU-HZ10ᵀ.

pmc-13201953.title: Use of patient-specific 3D reconstruction models for en bloc resection of primary thoracic vertebral sarcomas without formal spondylectomy: illustrative cases
pmc-13201953.creator: Vivek Sanker, Aaditya Dravid, Rebekka Miller, Chelsea Park, Maria Jose Cavagnaro, Ikchan Jeon, Corinna Zygourakis, Atman Desai
pmc-13201953.description: BACKGROUNDEn bloc resection remains the treatment of choice for primary vertebral column sarcomas but often necessitates total spondylectomy, a procedure associated with high morbidity. The use of patient-specific 3D reconstruction models in combination with intraoperative neuronavigation provides a strategy to achieve oncological resection goals while minimizing resection of uninvolved bone and reducing complication rates.

pmc-13405713.title: A Novel Indigoidine-like NRPS Gene from Arthrobacter antioxidans QL17 Enhances Oxidative Stress Resistance Through Radical Scavenging and Transcriptional Reprogramming
pmc-13405713.creator: Xue Yu, Yujie Wu, Wei Zhang, Gaosen Zhang, Shiyu Wu, Xiaomin Niu, Liguo Yang, Qi Feng, Tuo Chen, Guangxiu Liu
pmc-13405713.description: Water-soluble blue microbial pigments with antioxidant activity remain rare, and their host-level protective mechanisms are poorly understood. Here, we identified the genetic basis of blue pigment biosynthesis in the glacier-derived strain Arthrobacter antioxidans QL17. Heavy-ion mutagenesis yielded a hyperpigmented mutant (M157) and a pigment-deficient mutant (M186), and pigment yield was positively associated with hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) tolerance.

pmc-13565723.title: Age and Sex as Moderators of Sleep Architecture in Schizophrenia, Bipolar Disorder, and Unipolar Depression: A Case-Control Polysomnographic Systematic Review and Meta-Regression
pmc-13565723.creator: Dario Morra, Giuseppe Barbato
pmc-13565723.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummarySleep disturbances are among the most consistent biological findings in schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and unipolar depression. However, polysomnographic studies often report heterogeneous results, partly because of the imbalanced demographic composition of the populations investigated. We performed a transdiagnostic systematic review and meta-regression to investigate whether study-level age and sex contribute to variability in reported sleep abnormalities across these major psychiatric disorders.
